name: Seekh kebab
description: Spiced mince pressed onto skewers and cooked over coals.

tcm.note: Mince over direct fire with hot spice — hot by both meat and method.

ayurveda.note: Ushna in a high degree; grilling is the most heating way to cook.

unani.note: Garam-khushk; classic winter and celebration food.

histamine.note: Minced meat, often rested with papaya as a tenderiser — which adds a liberator.

nutrition.highlight: pressed onto skewers, cooked on coals
